description: Eleven requirements, written in the file with the monthly report first and expense submission in the middle. Each step needs the one before it: approval needs submitted expenses, payment needs approved ones, and the report reads approved ones. The plan orders its phases by that dependency, not by the order of the IDs, and every ID lands in exactly one phase.

must_match.why: the reply is the plan alone: it starts at the Approach heading, with no preamble
NFR-001 is a deadline on FR-008's response: same phase

must_not_match.why: approval (FR-003) is planned before the submission it approves (FR-006)
payment (FR-009) is planned before the approval that triggers it (FR-003)
the report of approved expenses (FR-001) is planned before approval (FR-003)
the payment confirmation (FR-010) is planned before the payment run (FR-009)
no Revision History, closing note, or rule in a chat reply

expectations: Each phase can merge on its own: no phase needs something that only a later phase builds.
No phase lists as Reuse something an earlier phase of this plan builds.
No requirement is added, reworded, or split.
manual: The Approach says the phases follow the flow, not the order of the IDs in the file.
